title: backlog.yaml and the operator's config.yaml
description: The layered result of one scope of `backlog.yaml` and `~/.config/bl/config.yaml` (core.md, "Configuration", D-87; F-136 D5). Each scope's result holds the keys of its layers and the merged `repos` map. `additionalProperties` is false, so each later feature adds its keys here and a typo is a fault. The loader adds no defaults (tenet 6).

color_scheme.description: The name of the color scheme: `bl` uses `config/color-schemes/<color_scheme>.yaml` (views.md, D-473; F-138 D2).

language.description: The language of the notification texts: `bl` uses `config/templates/<language>.yaml` (views.md, D-473; F-140 D2).

repos.description: Repo name to the repo's own entry, which the layers apply over the top level for work in that repo. A repo entry's `plugin_registry` defines only stages, and no `bl.notify`: shop steps, shop predicates and channels come from the top-level layers (steps.md, "Plugins", D-82; F-140 Decision A1).

id_prefixes.description: Id prefix to item type name, for example `S: story` (items.md, "Ids", D-601). The store reads an id's prefix and type from it (F-137 D3).

work_types.description: The item types whose items are work units, or belong to one (items.md, "Work types and work units"; graphs.md, "Graphs"; F-148 D1).

graphs.description: The backlog's graphs (graphs.md, "Graphs"; F-148 D1). Each graph's edges live in `graphs/<name>.json`, and its engine gives the file's shape and rules.

name.description: The graph's name, which gives its file `graphs/<name>.json`. Lower-case letters, digits and `-` only, so the file is directly under `graphs/` and its `.gitattributes` line needs no quoting: a `/`, `..`, a space or a line break would put the file elsewhere or break the line.

engine.description: The engine that gives the graph's file shape, rules and merge (graphs.md, D-603 to D-606).

nodes.description: The item types that may be nodes of the graph.

PluginRegistry.description: The shop's plugins, in three sections and nothing else (steps.md, "Plugins", D-82).

steps.description: The shop's own steps: a box uses one as `use: steps.<name>`, and its `with:` fills the command's `{{with.<key>}}` names.

predicates.description: The shop's own predicates: a condition calls one as `predicates.<name>(args…)`, with one argument for each `{{args.<n>}}` name of the command (D-481).

RepoPluginRegistry.description: A repo entry's plugins: only stages (F-140 Decision A1).

Stages.description: The stages that `bl` calls (steps.md, "The stages `bl` calls", D-80), and the shop's shared definitions: every key that does not start with `bl.`. A `bl.` name that `bl` does not call is a fault. `bl.format` and `bl.lint` come with their commands (F-153).

bl.change.description: The `bl.change` group, defined as a whole ("Stage names", D-79).

bl.notify.description: The channels: a channel name to its command (alerts.md, "Channels", D-99).

^(?!bl\\.).description: A shared definition: the stage's command under the stage's key (`regenerate: …`), plus that stage's fields (`paths`).

RepoStages.description: A repo entry's stages: no `bl.notify`, because the channels come from the top-level layers (F-140 Decision A1).

Stage.description: `none`, a list of names of shared definitions run in order, or one inline definition: a command, or an object that holds the stage's command under the stage's key, plus that stage's fields.

Plugin.description: A command (a Mustache template), or `{ command, exit_codes }`, where `exit_codes` maps a code from 1 to 125 to `success` or `failure` and overrides the shell's rule for that code only.
